subject: angol
title: Free time, culture and the media
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a szabadidődről, a kulturális programokról, az olvasásról és a médiáról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: How do you usually spend your free time, and has this changed in the last few years?
Do you think teenagers today have enough free time? Why or why not?
What was the last cultural event you went to, for example a concert, an exhibition or a play?
Do you prefer reading books on paper or on a screen? Why?
How do you decide which films or series to watch?
Where do you get your news from, and how do you know if it's reliable?
followUps: Have you ever believed a piece of fake news?

questions.q: Is it important for young people to go to the theatre or to museums? Why?
Which sport do you enjoy most, either playing or watching? Why?
How has the internet changed the way people spend their free time?
If you had a whole week off with no obligations, how would you spend it?

usefulPhrases.en: I rely on recommendations from friends.
I check it on several websites.
I'd make the most of it by ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Úgy használnám ki a legjobban, hogy ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How do you usually spend your free time, and has this changed in the last few years?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: These days I mostly play the guitar and meet my friends at the weekend. A few years ago I used to spend hours playing video games every day, but since I started a band with some classmates, I've spent much less time in front of a screen.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What was the last cultural event you went to, for example a concert, an exhibition or a play?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Last month our class went to a photography exhibition in Budapest about everyday life in Hungary in the 1980s. It was fascinating to see what my parents' childhood looked like.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Absolutely, especially to teenagers. It made history feel personal, and when I got home, it led to a really long conversation with my parents about their school years.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Where do you get your news from, and how do you know if it's reliable?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Mostly from social media, which I know isn't ideal. So if something sounds shocking, I check whether a reliable news site is reporting it, too, before I believe it or share it.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How has the internet changed the way people spend their free time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It's made entertainment available twenty-four hours a day, which is both a blessing and a curse. You can learn almost anything from online tutorials, but people also waste hours scrolling instead of doing things they'd really enjoy.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó mindegyik kérdésre részletesen felel, saját példákat hoz (zenekar, fotókiállítás, a hírek ellenőrzése), az általános kérdésnél pedig az internet előnyét és hátrányát is megmutatja.

Nyelvhelyesség: pontos és változatos igeidők – 'used to' a múltbeli szokásra, Present Perfect a 'since' után, Past Simple a konkrét eseménynél –, emellett 'make sth feel', valamint 'whether' és 'before' kezdetű mellékmondatok.
Szókincs: a kultúra és a média szavai (exhibition, reliable news site, online tutorials) és idiomatikus fordulatok (a blessing and a curse) adják a B2-es szintet.
Érdemes megtanulni: „which I know isn't ideal”, „It made history feel personal”, „both a blessing and a curse”, „in front of a screen”.
